remarks: COMING SOON! Offering over 3,000 square feet of living space, 4 spacious bedrooms, a large loft, 3-car garage, gated RV parking with full hook-ups and an incredible resort-style backyard, this home was made for those who love to entertain. Step inside to a flexible front living space originally designed as a formal living and dining room, but currently enjoyed as an entertainer’s room with a pool table that converts into a large dining table. The heart of the home is the open-concept chef’s kitchen featuring white cabinetry, dark granite countertops, stainless appliances, an oversized center island, large walk-in pantry, dining area, and breakfast bar seating.
